content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This breakdown focuses on the infrastructure needed to sell Notion templates for crypto, specifically targeting regions where conventional payment methods are limited. By using tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, digital creators can set up an automated system for selling products without the hefty fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. This framework not only allows for immediate access to funds but also keeps your customer data private and secure, aligning with the needs of creators who prioritize independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture employs Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital products and Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. This ensures that when a customer makes a purchase, their payment is processed through NOWPayments, which integrates seamlessly with your setup. The moment a payment is confirmed on-chain, your product is automatically delivered to the buyer. This entire process operates without the need for a middleman, allowing you to retain more of your earnings and gain complete control over your sales process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where access to reliable payment processors is often a challenge. By utilizing this sovereign stack, creators can effectively sell their products without fear of payment rejection or currency collapse. The focus on crypto payments also opens up new markets and customer bases that prefer using digital currencies, thus enhancing your potential sales opportunities.
Retain 921 more dollars with lower fees using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. Each piece works in unison to create a streamlined experience for both the seller and the buyer. The use of platforms like Supabase for order management and Google Drive for digital product delivery further ensures that your products are securely stored and easily accessible, providing a comprehensive solution for managing sales without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack, start by choosing Cloudflare Pages for your website hosting. Next, set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage backend processes. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you configure automatic delivery for your digital products. Load your products into the system, and test the entire flow to confirm that payments and deliveries operate smoothly. Finally, market your Notion templates directly to your audience, leveraging the reduced fees and complete ownership of your sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates cryptocurrency payments instead. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, you can facilitate transactions directly, avoiding traditional fees associated with other platforms. This approach not only maximizes your revenue but also secures your data ownership, allowing you to operate independently.
Automate your entire sales process and keep complete ownership of your data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to explore more about setting up a digital download store that exclusively accepts crypto, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your own sovereign stack. You can check out our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook online by integrating a sovereign stack that uses cryptocurrency payments via NOWPayments. This setup allows you to bypass PayPal and Stripe entirely, ensuring you retain greater control and lower fees.

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is by utilizing a self-hosted solution that accepts cryptocurrency payments. This method eliminates reliance on third-party services that charge high transaction fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by establishing your own digital store using platforms like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments for processing payments.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers low transaction fees of 0.5%, no KYC requirements, and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This allows you to maximize your profits while maintaining flexibility in payment options.
How can I automate product delivery after payment?

You can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools enable you to trigger automatic deliveries once a payment is confirmed on-chain, ensuring a seamless buying experience.
